## What's new

- All options in the editor's "Quick Settings" menu are now saved between sessions.
- Updated UNANIMATED integration (v0.1.18)
  - Added UI Show/Hide, Slide In/Out, CustomCameraOffset and CustomRotOffset options
  - Added Instant/Reversed modifiers for Custom Camera/Rotation commands
  - Increased precision of numbers by one more decimal place (0.1 -> 0.01)
  - (Tip: you can click on the number values to type in your own numbers)
- Updating the editor is now retried if it fails

**Happy mapping!**
